_comment: Add, edit or remove notes in entries, then from this folder run: node build.mjs. The build rewrites the journal landing page, each entry page and the Dev Journal URLs in sitemap.xml. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Newest is shown first. slug becomes the URL. category becomes a filter. Optional updated is YYYY-MM-DD. body is a list of paragraphs (strings) and blocks: {"h2":"..."}, {"h3":"..."}, {"list":["..."]}, {"numbers":["..."]}, {"quote":"..."}. Inline marks: **bold**, *italic*, [label](/path) or [label](https://...). images: [{src, alt, caption, width, height}]. videos: [{src, caption, poster, captions}] or [{embed, title, caption}] or [{placeholder:true, caption}]. YouTube and Vimeo watch links are converted to embeds. links: [{href, label}]. Entry folders are regenerated. Removing an entry and running the build deletes its generated page.
